identity_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent full-body 2D game helper sprite, single character, square canvas. Character identity reference: attached gemini.jpg. Redraw THIS purple cosmic cat girl as a polished 2.3-head-tall super-deformed chibi for a warm hand-drawn canteen game. Preserve her identity instead of turning her into a blue-haired maid. Mandatory large readable identifiers: tall triangular PURPLE CAT EARS with pink inner fur; lavender/periwinkle roots transitioning into strong PURPLE and MAGENTA flowing hair tips (NOT cyan tips); small curled side buns at both temples with long gently flowing hair; heterochromia, viewer-left eye bright ROSE PINK, viewer-right eye warm AMBER GOLD; one large gold-edged iridescent FOUR-POINT diamond/star hair ornament beside viewer-right ear. Costume faithfully simplified from reference: dark navy sleeveless celestial crop top, violet diagonal waist sash and a large four-point star jewel, detached wide navy sleeves with white/lilac inner fabric and gold edging, asymmetrical white pleated short skirt with dark navy/purple angular side panels and a few large star accents, white slouch boots with navy soles and purple accents. Small visible midriff, playful confident smile. One fluffy purple CAT TAIL with magenta tip curls to the viewer-left side, separate readable silhouette. NO maid headband, no apron, no maid collar/bib, no huge maid bows, no fish fins, no matching blue eyes, no blue ocean hairstyle, no text, no logos, no other characters, no floating stars outside her silhouette. Clean warm dark-indigo lineart, soft cel shading, slightly chunky readable shape language. Pose: front view, standing feet planted, BOTH empty hands raised beside the ears with palms upwards, ready to support a lunchbox drawn separately by the game; hands around 25 percent canvas height, do NOT draw any box or food. Entire character including ears, tail, hands and shoes must fit inside canvas with small 3-5 percent transparent margin. Center at x=50 percent; sole baseline at y=96 percent. Keep the face big, eyes highly legible at 160px sprite height. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground, no contact shadow. Only one full character, no sheet or inset.
asset_policy: Generated masters copied unchanged; no raster post-edit. Godot import generates mipmaps and limits the runtime textures to 512 px (standing/running/cheering) or 448 px (seated rest, for comparable head scale). Original gameplay size, speed, catch areas and save IDs are unchanged.

visual_capture.scope: Actual GPU rendering, four manually selected texture states alongside five unchanged helpers, light/dark background sheet. Positions and states are visual fixtures, not proof of human gameplay.
